mapper.select: select count(*) as value, if(gender = 1, '男性员工', '女性员工') as name from emp group by gender;

select d.name as name, count(e.id) as count from dept d left join emp e on e.dept_id = d.id group by d.id, d.name union all select '未分配部门' as name, count(*) as count from emp where dept_id is null or dept_id not in (select id from dept)
select count(*) as value, case degree when 1 then '初中' when 2 then '高中' when 3 then '大专' when 4 then '本科' when 5 then '硕士' when 6 then '博士' else '未分配' end as name from student group by degree

select c.name as name, count(s.id) as count from clazz c left join student s on c.id = s.clazz_id group by c.id, c.name
union all
select '未分配班级' as name, count(s.id) as count from student s where clazz_id is null or clazz_id not in (select id from clazz) order by count asc
